inspection_summary: Inspected all 263 normalized lines. The source builds a claimed RH proof from the Chebyshev/Nicolas equivalence, an Euler-product tail estimate, a Dedekind-psi asymptotic on primorial products, and a conditional contradiction lemma. The final synthesis is mathematically material but the text's stated inputs do not supply a rate or one-sided control for the Dedekind asymptotic, so the asserted eventual inequality is retained as a proof-gap-bearing unit rather than endorsed. Formula-risk artifacts are identified without reconstructing notation from outside the source.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Nicolas criterion through an eventual envelope
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The source reframes RH through a prime-product inequality encoded by f, then observes that an eventual exp(2/sqrt(x)) envelope would contradict the cited recurring growth behavior under RH failure.
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: This route is conditional: the lemma supplies a sufficient envelope but does not establish it.

within_source_synthesis_candidates.title: Euler-tail and Dedekind normalization bridge
within_source_synthesis_candidates.claim: The main proof rewrites the desired f-envelope as a product of an exponentially adjusted finite Euler product and R(M_x), aiming to pair convergence toward zeta(2) with convergence toward e^gamma/zeta(2).
within_source_synthesis_candidates.limit: From the source's displayed premises alone, asymptotic equivalence of R(M_x) gives neither a rate nor a side of approach, so the claimed eventual lower inequality does not follow as written.
